answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by pairing identities at random each epoch and making each pair independently answer the same fresh challenge. When two answers share sentence families or reasoning structure, both lose standing and locked funds — so a farm running one template across a thousand heads is betrayed by its own correlation. Each fake then needs genuinely independent thought every epoch, like timber cut from a different tree, while honest agents keep their harbor of past graded work and the reused relic of a copied answer only incriminates its owner.
